name: list_meetings
title: List meetings
description: List meetings from the catalog, newest first. `query` is a free-text search over meeting name, engagement and transcript text (use search_transcripts for segment-level hits). `range` filters by recording start time (inclusive from, exclusive to). `scope` is the confidentiality boundary and defaults to deny: omitted = only meetings with no scope; a single scope name = meetings in that scope plus unscoped meetings; an array of 2 or more names = explicit cross-scope query, which is written to the audit log. `limit` caps the number of results (1..500, default 50). Each meeting_summary may carry `active_job` — the queued / running job for that meeting with its progress (null or absent when none) — so a list UI can show progress without polling get_job_status per meeting. Read-only; use get_meeting for details. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: scope_denied, invalid_argument (bad range or limit), internal.

query.description: Free-text search (meeting name, engagement, transcript full-text). Omit to list all.

range.description: Filter by recording start time. Both bounds optional.

from.description: Include meetings started at or after this time.

to.description: Include meetings started before this time.

scope.description: Omitted = unscoped meetings only. One name = that scope + unscoped. Array of 2+ names = cross-scope query (audit-logged).

limit.description: Maximum number of meetings to return (1..500, default 50).
